name: Steel Shuttering Plates
shortDescription: Heavy-duty steel plates for concrete formwork in all standard sizes.
fullDescription: Our steel shuttering plates are manufactured from high-grade MS steel, ensuring flatness and reuse up to 200 cycles. Available in sizes from 1ft x 2ft to 4ft x 8ft. Ideal for slabs, beams, columns, and walls.

name: Aluminium Scaffolding Systems
shortDescription: Lightweight, rust-free aluminium scaffolding for safe elevated work.
fullDescription: Our aluminium scaffolding towers are ideal for construction, painting, plastering, and maintenance work. Lightweight yet load-bearing up to 250 kg per platform. Easy to assemble without tools. Complies with IS standards.

name: Steel Props (Acrow Props)
shortDescription: Adjustable steel props for supporting slabs and beams during construction.
fullDescription: Heavy-duty adjustable acrow props for temporary support of formwork and slabs. Height range: 1.8m to 3.3m. Load capacity up to 3 tonnes. Available in bulk quantities for large projects.

name: H-Frame Scaffolding
shortDescription: Traditional H-frame scaffold systems for large-scale construction facades.
fullDescription: Robust H-frame scaffolding for multi-storey building construction, bridge work, and industrial sites. Galvanised finish for weather resistance. Compatible with standard cross-braces and walk boards.

name: Centering Plates & Jacks
shortDescription: Complete centering systems for floor slab construction.
fullDescription: Full range of centering equipment including plates, beams, and adjustable jacks. Available as complete sets or individual components. Suitable for residential and commercial slab work of all spans.

name: Wholesale Supply
shortDescription: Bulk procurement of shuttering and scaffolding materials for dealers.
fullDescription: We supply to contractors, sub-dealers, and construction companies across Uttar Pradesh at wholesale rates. Minimum order quantities apply. GST invoice provided. Credit available for regular buyers.
